newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela postpones privatisation debate till Wed.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela postpones privatisation debate till Wed.

text.p: Venezuela has postponed debate of the Privatisation Law Reform Bill until Wednesday morning after students protesting the government's reform program blocked streets around Congress, legislators said.
"If it hadn't been for the disturbances, the bill would have been passed," union-based Radical Cause Senator Jose Lira told Reuters.
Twenty six senators are required for quorum, Lira added, "but we only had 22."

The bill paves the way for small local investors to buy shares on the Caracas stock exchange. Its importance had been highlighted ahead of the expected November global share offering of the government's 40 percent stake in telephone company CANTV.
